_readme: Copy to config.json (git-ignored: it holds passwords) and fill in server and, if you have one, developer. Everything else works as it is. Keys starting with _ are comments. README.md explains each one.

server._base_url: The API to test. Use a test server and database -- never the review site's.
server._email: A super admin (python tools/grant_access.py --set-superuser --email ...). Without it the priority, held-queue and cap scenarios are skipped.
server._same_machine: true: this script runs on the API's machine. Then it also runs analyzer.py (the command-line scenarios), stops a run's process (interrupted), and looks for folders a cancel must remove.

developer._: A second user, NOT a super admin -- the script makes them a developer of its projects to test who may do what. Make one: python analyzer.py user add --email dev@example.com --name Dev (it prints the password). Leave email empty to skip those checks.

sample._source_dir: The SampleCppProject code to test with: a folder on this machine -- a copy with fewer components makes every run shorter. It is copied, never changed; a .git in it is left out. Empty: the repository's own SampleCppProject. Every folder projects.architecture_layers names must be in it.
sample._repo_dir: The folder for the git copy of SampleCppProject the server clones: each run makes a new jst-sample-<time> folder in it. Empty: the first repositories.localRoots of config.local.json that does not hold the sample code, else the temp folder. When the server lists repositories.localRoots, this folder must be inside one of them (add it to the list -- the script says so before it creates anything). Keep it short on Windows.

projects._count: How many projects. 0: enough to fill the server's cap and one more (at least 3; 4 in complex mode).
projects._build_config: The projects' own settings -- empty: the server's config.defaults.json, as for any new project.
projects._architecture_layers: The sample's components: App, Math, Outer and Sample of Layer1. A short run is one component; the first group, of two or more components, is the first version of a project and where an incremental change goes; the last group's first folder is the one a failing commit removes. At least 3 groups.

cli._enabled: The command-line scenarios run analyzer.py here: it must use the API's database (the same config.local.json db, or the same DATABASE_URL).

complex._manage_api: complex and cli modes. true: the script starts the API itself (python -m uvicorn api.main:app, on the port of server.base_url), restarts it for the restart scenarios, and runs it under the jobs settings each scenario needs -- from a copy of config.local.json in its log folder, yours never written. Stop your own API on this database first -- one API per database.
complex._use_llm: The LLM scenario runs only when config.local.json has an llmServer and this is true.
complex._max_wait_minutes: The longest it waits for the server's own clocks (jobs.interruptedAfterMinutes, jobs.pausedDays). With manage_api the script sets them short itself; against your own API, longer settings skip those checks, saying so.

cleanup._delete_projects: true: the test projects (their versions and documents with them) are deleted at the end. --keep overrides it.
